data.title: Colors — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey there, new neighbors… 

[Hook]
Bright red… Rojo brillante  
Dark blue… Azul oscuro  
Colors everywhere, can you see?  
Colors everywhere, ven y míralas aquí  

[Verse]
Walking down the street, feeling free,  
I see a house, painted beautifully.  
Light green… Verde claro  
Lemon yellow… Amarillo limón  
The colors dance in the sun's bright glow.  
Coal black… Negro como el carbón  
Snow white… Blanco nieve  
Every shade tells a story, you know.  
Neighbors wave, "Hello… Hola"  
I smile back, "How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?"  
Let's get to know each other today.  

[Hook]  
Bright red… Rojo brillante  
Dark blue… Azul oscuro  
Colors everywhere, can you see?  
Colors everywhere, ven y míralas aquí  

[Verse]  
The sky's so blue, azul y claro,  
Flowers bloom, showing their arcoíris.  
Pale pink… Rosa pálido  
Vibrant orange… Naranja vibrante  
Nature's palette, isn't it great?  
White clouds… Nubes blancas  
Pink sunset… Atardecer rosa  
Every moment, colors create.
